evidence.quote:
Every Meridian deployment now requires a signed release
manifest before it ships.

observations.why: Declarative that performs a settled operational rule — 'now requires' ratifies the gate as in force, not argued for.

evidence.quote:
We saw two unsigned artifacts reach staging
last quarter and that is the whole reason for the gate.

observations.why: Assertive justification for the gate — a factual claim offered in defense, not the ratification itself; the causal 'that is the whole reason' is explanatory, not settling.
The document's own framing labels what follows as settled outcomes, performing the ratification of the gate as decided.

evidence.quote: signed release manifest required for Meridian deploys

observations.why: 'required' states an operational rule with no hedge — the document records the gate as load-bearing and settled.
Scope extension stated as a flat operational rule — no hedging, no alternatives voiced; the document records it as decided.
Assigning ownership is a performed ratification — the document settles accountability as part of the decision record.

mints.name: OperationalGateRatification
mints.title: a gate stated as a settled, load-bearing operational rule
mints.frame: Is the conviction here performed as a ratified operational rule the speaker expects others to act on, rather than as a position still being argued for?
